result_summary.rng_get_defined_by: ports/stm32/rng.o (upstream MicroPython fork), as a global T symbol
result_summary.confirms: MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_RNG=0 on this board causes MicroPython's own Yasmarang-fallback rng.c to compile and be the sole global definer of rng_get(); the board's rng.c never shadows it on this tag. Matches evidence/commits/findings.md sections 5-6, now confirmed by an actual compiled and linked binary rather than source reading alone.

notes: This is NOT the official Coinkite release build (no signing keys, no bootloader flashing, no comparison against a published .dfu). It is a from-source build of the same commit using the project's own documented Docker toolchain and Makefile target, sufficient to inspect symbol resolution.

make setup was run first to create the boards/COLDCARD and boards/COLDCARD_MK4 symlinks into external/micropython/ports/stm32/boards/, build libsecp256k1 inside external/libngu, and build mpy-cross. See build.log for full setup and build output.
